sources.fullCitation: Eddy Duchin and His Orchestra, vocal by Lew Sherwood. “You’re All I Need.” Words by Gus Kahn; music by Bronisław Kaper and Walter Jurmann. Victor 25029, matrix BS-89700-1. Recorded New York, 29 April 1935; issued 8 May 1935. Discography of American Historical Recordings data noted in evidence; online playback via YouTube video xibMGdnilK0.

media.title: You’re All I Need — video reference
media.description: Kaper-Jurmann's first American song, written for William Powell's Viennese comedy at MGM. Ranked No. 14 on the ASCAP list of most-played songs of 1935–36, with over 21,000 radio broadcasts on NBC and CBS — placing the newcomers alongside Irving Berlin and Jerome Kern.
